scenario: 自动驾驶车队每天回传数百万帧常规公路画面,团队提议"多记日志、被动积累"来覆盖罕见安全场景。
scenario_en: An autonomous fleet logs millions of routine highway frames daily; the team proposes passively accumulating more logs to cover rare safety scenarios.
q: 为什么被动车队日志填不上罕见事件缺口?
q_en: Why can't passive fleet logging close the rare-event gap?
why: 帧分布是幂律长尾:约 95% 是常规行驶,儿童冲出、黄昏轮椅这类安全关键场景合计不到一个百分点。被动记录按真实频率采样,只会越堆越多常规帧、长尾几乎不涨,所以数据策略才是安全关键检测里最高杠杆的决策。
why_en: The frame distribution is a power-law long tail, so passive logging just piles up routine frames while safety-critical cases stay under a percent, which is why data strategy is the highest-leverage decision.
options: 帧分布是幂律:约 95% 是常规行驶,安全关键长尾不到千分之几,被动记录只会堆更多常规帧
因为车载存储不够大,多数罕见帧在回传前就被覆盖删除,扩容硬盘即可解决缺口
因为标注团队来不及标常规帧,罕见帧其实已经采够,瓶颈只在标注产能
因为传感器在罕见场景下失灵采不到数据,换更高帧率相机就能补上长尾
options_en: The distribution is power-law: about 95% routine driving, safety-critical tail well under a percent, so passive logging only piles up more routine frames.
Because onboard storage is too small, most rare frames get overwritten before upload, and bigger disks would fix the gap.
Because labelers can't keep up with routine frames; rare frames are already sufficient and the only bottleneck is labeling throughput.
Because sensors fail in rare scenarios and can't capture data, so higher-frame-rate cameras would fill the tail.
optionExplanations: 对;幂律下被动采样按真实频率走,常规帧涨得飞快、长尾原地踏步,必须主动干预才补得上。
存储不是瓶颈:就算全存下来,罕见帧本来就极少,扩容只是存了更多常规帧。
说反了:罕见帧恰恰是不够的那部分,标注产能救不了源头就采不到的样本。
传感器在罕见场景通常正常工作,问题是这类场景本身罕见,不是采不到。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — under a power law, passive sampling follows real frequency, so routine frames explode while the tail stalls; you must intervene actively.
Storage isn't the bottleneck: even keeping everything, rare frames are inherently scarce, so bigger disks just store more routine frames.
Backwards — rare frames are exactly the scarce part; labeling throughput can't fix samples the source never captures.
Sensors usually work fine in rare scenarios; the problem is such scenarios are rare, not uncapturable.

termDefinitions.meaning: 少数常见类占绝大多数样本,大量罕见类各自极少,合起来是尾部。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A power-law long tail means a few common classes dominate the samples while many rare classes are each tiny, together forming the tail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 漏检会直接危及安全的场景/类别,如行人、儿童、轮椅、路面碎片。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Safety-critical refers to scenarios or classes where a miss directly endangers safety, like pedestrians, children, wheelchairs, or road debris.

q: 安全关键目标检测的四大数据策略支柱是哪四个?
q_en: What are the four pillars of data strategy for safety-critical object detection?
why: 四支柱:①按成本/精度和融合需求选标注类型 ②长尾/罕见事件处理 ③合成数据补不可采集场景 ④主动学习把标注预算投给最有信息量的帧。L5/Staff+ 要在讲模型架构之前先讲清这四点。
why_en: The four pillars are annotation-type selection, long-tail handling, synthetic data, and active learning, and at Staff+ you articulate all four before model architecture.
diagram:
flowchart TD D["数据策略
安全关键检测最高杠杆"] --> P1["1 标注类型"] D --> P2["2 长尾处理"] D --> P3["3 合成数据"] D --> P4["4 主动学习"]
options: 标注类型选择、长尾处理、合成数据、主动学习
模型架构、损失函数、优化器、学习率调度
数据增强、正则化、dropout、早停
相机标定、传感器同步、时间戳对齐、坐标变换
options_en: Annotation-type selection, long-tail / rare-event handling, synthetic data, and active learning.
Model architecture, loss function, optimizer, and learning-rate schedule.
Data augmentation, regularization, dropout, and early stopping.
Camera calibration, sensor sync, timestamp alignment, and coordinate transforms.
optionExplanations: 对;这四项都在决定"模型见到什么数据、花多少钱标",是安全关键检测的高杠杆环节。
这些是建模/优化侧的选择,数据没搞对时它们救不了长尾覆盖。
增强/正则是训练技巧,只是长尾处理里的一小环,不是四支柱本身。
标定与同步是传感器工程,属于数据采集前置,不构成数据策略的四支柱。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — all four decide what data the model sees and how much labeling costs, the high-leverage levers in safety-critical detection.
These are modeling/optimization choices; they can't fix tail coverage when the data itself is wrong.
Augmentation and regularization are training tricks, one sub-part of long-tail handling, not the four pillars.
Calibration and sync are sensor engineering upstream of data, not the four data-strategy pillars.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让模型挑出最有信息量的样本优先标注,以最小标注量换最大精度提升。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Active learning lets the model pick the most informative samples to label first, buying the most accuracy per labeled sample.

scenario: L5/Staff+ 面试让你设计自动驾驶的目标检测系统,你只有有限时间展示判断力。
scenario_en: An L5/Staff+ interview asks you to design object detection for autonomous driving, with limited time to show judgment.
q: 开场最该先讲什么,才显出资深数据判断力?
q_en: What should you lead with to show senior-level data judgment?
why: 安全关键检测的成败主要由长尾数据覆盖决定,不是网络结构;资深信号是先把数据策略四支柱讲透,再谈架构。反过来先秀模型会显得只懂调包、没抓住真正瓶颈。
why_en: In safety-critical detection the tail-data coverage dominates outcomes, so leading with the four data-strategy pillars before architecture is the Staff-level signal.
tradeoff: 先讲数据策略(抓真正瓶颈) vs 先讲模型架构(显得只懂调包)
options: 先系统对比 YOLO、EfficientDet、DETR 的精度-延迟曲线和适用场景
先给出边缘部署的剪枝(pruning)、量化(quantization)与算子融合完整加速方案
先设计置信度校准、NMS 阈值与多尺度特征金字塔结构
先讲清数据策略四支柱,因为安全关键检测里数据是最高杠杆,架构在其后
options_en: First compare YOLO, EfficientDet, and DETR on their accuracy-latency curves and use cases.
First lay out a full edge-deployment speedup plan with pruning, quantization, and operator fusion.
First design confidence calibration, NMS thresholds, and a multi-scale feature pyramid.
First nail the four data-strategy pillars, since data is the highest leverage here and architecture comes after.
whenOtherWins: 如果岗位明确是边缘推理/编译优化,或数据管线已成熟、瓶颈确实在延迟,那架构与量化才是该先深入的重点。
optionExplanations: 架构对比是必要环节,但放在开场会本末倒置——长尾覆盖没解决,选哪个检测器都过不了安全线。
剪枝/量化是部署侧优化,救的是延迟/功耗,不是罕见事件漏检这个安全关键的核心风险。
校准和 NMS 是精度打磨细节,前提是训练数据已覆盖长尾;数据没铺好时它们无从谈起。
对;先讲数据策略四支柱,把最高杠杆的决策讲透,再谈架构,是资深数据判断力的信号。
optionExplanations_en: Architecture comparison matters, but leading with it inverts priorities — no detector clears the safety bar until tail coverage is solved.
Pruning/quantization is deployment-side, helping latency and power, not the core safety risk of missing rare events.
Calibration and NMS are accuracy polish that assume the training data already covers the tail, which it doesn't yet.
Correct — leading with the four data pillars surfaces the highest-leverage decision before architecture, the senior-level signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单阶段实时检测器族,一次前向同时回归框和类别,快但小目标偏弱。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YOLO (You Only Look Once) is a single-stage real-time detector family that regresses boxes and classes in one pass, fast but weaker on small objects.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 EfficientNet 主干加 BiFPN 的检测器,主打精度-算力效率平衡。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: EfficientDet is a detector using an EfficientNet backbone with BiFPN, tuned for accuracy-per-compute efficiency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用 Transformer 做集合预测的检测器,去掉了手工 NMS。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DETR (DEtection TRansformer) is a Transformer-based detector that does set prediction and removes hand-crafted NMS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 剪枝删冗余权重、量化降数值精度,都是给边缘部署压缩模型、加速推理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pruning removes redundant weights and quantization lowers numeric precision, both compressing models to speed up edge inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 后处理:同一物体的重叠框只留置信度最高的,抑制其余。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NMS (Non-Maximum Suppression) is post-processing that keeps only the highest-confidence box among overlapping boxes for one object.

q: 关于三种标注类型的成本与空间信息,哪个说法正确?
q_en: Which statement about the three annotation types' cost and spatial info is correct?
why: 三者是成本-信息的阶梯:2D 框 1x 只给 2D、分割 5-10x 给精确边界、3D 点云 10-15x 给完整深度用于融合测距。选哪种由该阶段的融合需求决定,不是越贵越好。
why_en: The three form a cost-information ladder from 1x 2D boxes to 10-15x 3D point clouds, and you pick by the fusion need at that stage, not by price.
tradeoff: 成本 vs 空间信息:2D 框便宜无深度 vs 3D 点云昂贵但给融合所需深度
options: 2D 边界框和 3D 点云成本相同,都不含深度信息
分割掩码成本最低,且能给出完整 3D 深度
3D 点云成本最高(10-15x),但唯一能给完整 3D 深度/位置/朝向,支撑传感器融合
2D 边界框成本最高,因为需要专门的 LiDAR 标注工具
options_en: 2D boxes and 3D point clouds cost the same and neither carries depth.
Segmentation masks are the cheapest and give full 3D depth.
3D point clouds cost the most (10-15x) but uniquely give full 3D depth, position, and orientation for sensor fusion.
2D boxes cost the most because they need specialized LiDAR annotation tooling.
optionExplanations: 错;2D 框是 1x 最便宜且无深度,3D 点云是 10-15x 且有深度,两者成本和信息都不同。
反了;分割是 5-10x 不是最便宜,而且它只给精确 2D 边界,没有深度维度。
对;只有 3D 点云带完整 3D 几何,支撑融合测距/轨迹,代价是 10-15x 成本加专用工具。
错;需要 LiDAR 专用工具的是 3D 点云;2D 框恰恰是单相机最便宜的那一种。
optionExplanations_en: Wrong — 2D boxes are the cheapest at 1x with no depth, while 3D point clouds are 10-15x with depth; both cost and info differ.
Backwards — segmentation is 5-10x, not cheapest, and gives only a precise 2D boundary, no depth dimension.
Correct — only 3D point clouds carry full 3D geometry for fusion distance/trajectory, at 10-15x cost plus specialized tooling.
Wrong — 3D point clouds are what need LiDAR tooling; 2D boxes are the cheapest single-camera option.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个矩形框住物体,给 2D 位置和大小,不含深度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounding box wraps an object in a rectangle giving 2D position and size, with no depth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 逐像素标出物体轮廓,边界精确、能分离重叠物,但没有深度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segmentation mask labels the object outline pixel by pixel, precise and able to separate overlaps, but without depth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由 LiDAR/深度传感器得到的 3D 点集,带完整深度、位置和朝向。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A point cloud is a 3D set of points from LiDAR or depth sensors, carrying full depth, position, and orientation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 激光雷达:发激光测距,输出 3D 点云,自动驾驶测距/融合的关键传感器。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) fires laser pulses to measure distance, producing 3D point clouds key to fusion and ranging.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把相机、LiDAR、雷达等多源数据合并,得到更可靠的距离/轨迹估计。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sensor fusion combines camera, LiDAR, and radar data into more reliable distance and trajectory estimates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个物体被另一个部分挡住,矩形框会把背景一起框进来。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Occlusion is when one object partly hides another, so a rectangular box ends up including background.

scenario: 单相机、算力受限,想快速 bootstrap 一个检测器的训练数据。
scenario_en: Single camera and limited compute; you want to bootstrap a detector's training data quickly.
q: 2D 边界框标注的成本与主要局限是什么?
q_en: What are the cost and main limitation of 2D bounding-box annotation?
why: 2D 框是最便宜的标注(1x),单相机就能标、快,适合 bootstrap;但遮挡时矩形框会把背景一起框进去,边界不准,所以后续要靠分割掩码细化。
why_en: A 2D box is the cheapest annotation at 1x and fast on a single camera, but under occlusion the rectangle includes background, so segmentation refines it later.
options: 5-10x 成本,像素级精确,能分离重叠物体
1x 成本、单相机快速,但遮挡下退化——矩形框会把背景一起框进来
10-15x 成本,提供完整 3D 深度,适合测距
零成本,可由 LiDAR 自动生成,没有任何局限
options_en: 5-10x cost, pixel-precise, and can separate overlapping objects.
1x cost and fast on a single camera, but degrades under occlusion — the rectangle includes background.
10-15x cost, provides full 3D depth, and suits distance estimation.
Zero cost, auto-generated from LiDAR, with no limitations at all.
optionExplanations: 那是分割掩码的画像;2D 框只给矩形,做不到像素级分离重叠物。
对;1x 最便宜、单相机快,适合起步,但遮挡时框进背景是它的固有短板。
完整 3D 深度是 3D 点云的能力;2D 框只有 2D 位置和大小,没有深度。
2D 框需要人工标,不是零成本;它也有遮挡退化的明显局限。
optionExplanations_en: That describes a segmentation mask; a 2D box gives only a rectangle and can't pixel-separate overlaps.
Correct — 1x cheapest and fast on one camera for bootstrapping, but including background under occlusion is its built-in weakness.
Full 3D depth is a 3D point cloud's ability; a 2D box has only 2D position and size, no depth.
2D boxes need human labeling, not zero cost, and they clearly degrade under occlusion.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用最便宜快速的数据先把模型跑起来,拿到可用基线再逐步升级标注质量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bootstrapping means starting the model on the cheapest, fastest data to get a working baseline before upgrading annotation quality.

q: 分割掩码(segmentation mask)相比 2D 框的核心优势是什么?
q_en: What is the segmentation mask's core advantage over a 2D box?
why: 分割掩码给像素级精确边界,能把重叠/被遮挡的物体分开,这是矩形框做不到的;代价是 5-10x 成本,而且场景越复杂(边界越碎)成本越高。
why_en: A segmentation mask gives a pixel-precise boundary that separates overlapping or occluded objects, which a rectangle can't, at 5-10x cost that rises with scene complexity.
options: 像素级精确边界,能分离重叠/被遮挡物体;代价是 5-10x 成本且随场景复杂度上升
提供完整 3D 深度和朝向,直接支撑传感器融合测距
成本与 2D 框相同,但天生抗遮挡,无需额外标注投入
无需相机,只靠 LiDAR 点云即可自动生成掩码
options_en: A pixel-precise boundary that separates overlapping/occluded objects, at 5-10x cost that rises with scene complexity.
It provides full 3D depth and orientation, directly supporting fusion-based ranging.
It costs the same as a 2D box but is inherently occlusion-proof with no extra labeling effort.
It needs no camera and is auto-generated from LiDAR point clouds alone.
optionExplanations: 对;像素边界能把挨着的物体分开,是分割相对 2D 框的关键价值,代价是 5-10x 且随复杂度涨。
3D 深度和朝向是点云的能力;分割仍是 2D 的,只是边界更精确,没有深度。
成本不同:分割是 5-10x 不是 1x;它靠额外像素标注换来的抗遮挡,不是免费。
掩码是像素级的图像标注,由人在图像上标,不是靠点云自动生成。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — the pixel boundary separates adjacent objects, segmentation's key value over a box, at 5-10x cost that scales with complexity.
3D depth and orientation are the point cloud's ability; segmentation is still 2D, just with a more precise boundary.
Costs differ: segmentation is 5-10x not 1x, and its occlusion handling comes from extra pixel labeling, not for free.
A mask is pixel-level image annotation done by humans on the image, not auto-generated from point clouds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 逐像素标出物体轮廓,边界精确、能分离重叠物,但没有深度信息。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segmentation mask labels the object outline pixel by pixel, precise and able to separate overlaps, but with no depth.

scenario: 系统要预测前方行人的距离和运动轨迹,做 LiDAR + 相机的传感器融合。
scenario_en: The system must predict a pedestrian's distance and trajectory using LiDAR + camera sensor fusion.
q: 融合测距/轨迹这一环最该投哪种标注?
q_en: Which annotation should you invest in for fusion-based distance/trajectory?
why: 融合测距/轨迹需要真实 3D 几何,只有 LiDAR 点云标注能给深度/位置/朝向;2D 框和分割都没有深度维度。代价是 10-15x 成本,要专用工具和受训标注员。
why_en: Fusion distance and trajectory need real 3D geometry, so only 3D point-cloud labels carry the depth and orientation, at 10-15x cost with specialized tooling.
tradeoff: 3D 点云(有深度支撑融合、但 10-15x 且要专用工具) vs 2D 框(便宜但无深度)
options: 2D 边界框,单相机快速且便宜,足够估计距离
分割掩码,像素边界精确,能直接给出深度
3D 点云,唯一提供完整 3D 深度/位置/朝向,支撑融合测距与轨迹
只用图像分类标签,让模型自己回归距离
options_en: 2D bounding boxes — fast and cheap on a single camera, enough to estimate distance.
Segmentation masks — the precise pixel boundary directly yields depth.
3D point clouds — the only one giving full 3D depth, position, and orientation for fusion ranging and trajectory.
Just image-classification labels and let the model regress distance itself.
whenOtherWins: 若只做单相机 2D 检测、不需要距离/轨迹(如判断车道内是否有物体),2D 框就够,不必上 10-15x 成本的 3D 点云。
optionExplanations: 2D 框没有深度,单相机估距要靠强假设,融合测距/轨迹这种安全关键环节不能赌。
分割再精确也是 2D 边界,不含深度,给不了融合所需的距离信息。
对;只有点云带 3D 几何,能锚定融合的深度/朝向;代价是 10-15x 成本加专用标注。
分类标签只有类别没有位置和距离,模型无从稳定回归 3D 轨迹。
optionExplanations_en: A 2D box has no depth; single-camera ranging leans on strong assumptions you can't gamble on for safety-critical fusion.
However precise, segmentation is a 2D boundary with no depth, so it can't supply the distance fusion needs.
Correct — only point clouds carry 3D geometry to anchor fusion depth/orientation, at 10-15x cost plus specialized labeling.
Classification labels give class but no position or distance, so the model can't reliably regress a 3D trajectory.

termDefinitions.meaning: 激光雷达:发激光测距,输出 3D 点云,是融合测距的关键传感器。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) fires laser pulses to measure distance, producing 3D point clouds key to fusion ranging.

termDefinitions.meaning: 物体随时间的运动路径,需要连续的 3D 位置估计才能可靠预测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A trajectory is an object's path over time, needing continuous 3D position estimates to predict reliably.

q: 补全:生产中三种标注在不同阶段的分工。
q_en: Fill in: how the three annotation types split across production stages.
text: 生产中三种标注用在不同阶段:{{2D 边界框}}用来 bootstrap 训练、{{分割掩码}}细化遮挡边界、{{3D 点云}}锚定融合关键的距离与轨迹。
text_en: In production the three annotation types serve different stages: {{2D boxes}} bootstrap training, {{segmentation masks}} refine occlusion boundaries, and {{3D point clouds}} anchor fusion-critical distance and trajectory.
why: 不是二选一,而是三者按阶段分工:先用便宜的 2D 框快速起步,再用分割补遮挡边界,最后用 3D 点云支撑融合。把每种标注挂到具体管线阶段,而不是列成一张泛泛的清单。
why_en: They're staged, not either-or: cheap 2D boxes bootstrap, segmentation refines occlusion, and 3D point clouds anchor fusion — tie each type to a pipeline stage, not a generic list.
diagram:
flowchart LR A["2D 框
bootstrap 训练"] --> B["分割掩码
细化遮挡边界"] --> C["3D 点云
锚定融合测距/轨迹"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 把不同成本的标注按训练成熟度分配到不同阶段,便宜的先上、贵的用在刀刃。

scenario: 预算有限,要在 2D 框(1x)、分割(5-10x)、3D 点云(10-15x)之间分配标注投入。

why: 它们是多模态、大规模的优质数据集,但采集方式仍是真实路况,尾部事件(儿童冲出、恶劣天气)本就罕见,所以数据集里也严重欠采样,不能直接覆盖罕见场景。
why_en: They're large multi-modal datasets, but collected from real driving, so rare tail events stay severely underrepresented and can't cover rare scenarios directly.

scenario_en: Frames follow a power law: about 95% routine driving, the safety-critical tail (children, wheelchairs, animals, debris) under one percent combined.
q: 这个 95% / <1% 的分布对训练采样意味着什么?
q_en: What does the 95% / <1% distribution imply for training sampling?
why: 95% 常规、<1% 尾部是经验性的幂律形状,不是公式,它是采样设计的基数。按真实频率均匀采样,一个 batch 里罕见类可能一个都没有、梯度学不到,所以必须用过采样、定向采集把尾部提到有意义的 batch 占比。
why_en: The empirical 95%-routine, sub-1%-tail shape is the sampling design base: uniform sampling can leave a batch with zero rare-class frames, so you oversample or target-collect to lift the tail to a meaningful fraction.
options: 均匀随机采样会让 batch 几乎全是常规帧,尾部信号被淹没——必须过采样或定向采集让模型见到罕见类

q: 以下哪些是处理长尾/罕见事件的数据策略?(多选)
q_en: Which of these are data strategies for handling long-tail / rare events? (multiple)
why: 长尾有四个数据侧策略:过采样、定向采集、尺度感知增强、子模选择,全都在改"模型见到什么数据";加深网络、调学习率是优化侧,救不了训练数据里罕见类几乎不出现这个根因。
why_en: The long-tail levers are oversampling, targeted collection, scale-aware augmentation, and submodular selection — all changing what data the model sees, unlike deeper nets which don't fix missing rare classes.
options: 过采样:训练时提高罕见类帧的采样率
定向车队采集:车载启发式触发时高清抓取异常场景
尺度感知增强:随机裁剪、尺度抖动、mosaic 保持真实尺寸
加深网络层数、调大学习率来"记住"罕见类
options_en: Oversampling: raise the sampling rate of rare-class frames during training.
Targeted fleet collection: onboard heuristics trigger high-res capture of unusual scenes.
Scale-aware augmentation: random crop, scale jitter, and mosaic that preserve realistic sizes.
Deepen the network and raise the learning rate to 'memorize' rare classes.
optionExplanations: 对;把 0.1% 的儿童行人帧上采到有意义的 batch 占比,让梯度真正看到罕见类。
对;不是被动记录,而是触发式主动采集——急刹、异形、低能见度时才高清抓拍,直击尾部。
对;用随机裁剪、尺度抖动、mosaic 造多尺度样本,但校准到真实距离尺寸,才不损精度。
错;加深网络、调大学习率属于优化侧,数据里没有的罕见类它们变不出来。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — up-weight 0.1% child-pedestrian frames to a meaningful batch fraction so the gradient actually sees rare classes.
Correct — not passive logging but trigger-based active capture on hard braking, odd shapes, or low visibility, hitting the tail directly.
Correct — random crop, scale jitter, and mosaic build multi-scale samples, calibrated to realistic distances so accuracy isn't hurt.
Wrong — deeper nets and higher learning rates are optimization-side and don't fix rare classes barely appearing in the data.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Oversampling raises how often rare-class samples are drawn during training so the gradient reflects them more.

q: 过采样(oversampling)在长尾检测里具体怎么做,要注意什么代价?
q_en: How does oversampling work in long-tail detection, and what's the cost to watch?
why: 过采样在训练采样阶段提高罕见类频率——把 0.1% 的儿童行人帧上采到有意义的 batch 占比,否则梯度几乎学不到它。代价是过度重复少量样本可能过拟合,所以常配数据增强一起用。
why_en: Oversampling raises rare-class frequency at train time so 0.1% child-pedestrian frames reach a meaningful batch fraction, risking overfit to few samples, so it pairs with augmentation.
tradeoff: 过采样(让梯度看到罕见类) vs 过度重复少量样本(过拟合风险)
options: 训练时复制常规帧,让数据集整体变大以提升泛化
推理时对罕见类降低置信度阈值,提高召回
训练时把 0.1% 罕见帧上采到有意义的 batch 占比,代价是易过拟合
删除常规帧直到各类别样本数量完全相等以求均衡
options_en: Duplicate routine frames at train time to enlarge the dataset and improve generalization.
Lower the confidence threshold for rare classes at inference to raise recall.
At train time up-weight 0.1% child-pedestrian frames to a meaningful batch fraction, at the cost of possibly overfitting few samples.
Delete routine frames until every class has exactly equal counts.
optionExplanations: 复制常规帧只会让本已占主导的类更主导,和过采样罕见类的目标正好相反。
调阈值是推理侧后处理,改的是判定边界,不解决训练里罕见类看不到的问题。
对;过采样在训练采样阶段提罕见类频率,让梯度学到它;代价是少量样本被反复看易过拟合,需配增强。
把常规帧删到相等会丢掉大量真实分布信息,还可能欠拟合常见场景,不是过采样。
optionExplanations_en: Duplicating routine frames makes the already-dominant class more dominant, the opposite of oversampling rare classes.
Threshold tuning is inference-side post-processing; it shifts the decision boundary but not the unseen rare classes in training.
Correct — oversampling raises rare-class frequency at sampling time so the gradient learns it, risking overfit to few samples, hence pairing with augmentation.
Deleting routine frames to equal counts loses real distribution info and can underfit common scenes; that isn't oversampling.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型死记少量训练样本,泛化到新样本时反而变差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Overfitting is when a model memorizes a few training samples and generalizes worse to new ones.

scenario: 想在真实道路上多拿到"儿童冲出""异形障碍物"这类罕见帧,但不能无脑回传所有画面(带宽/存储爆炸)。
scenario_en: You want more rare frames like child-darting and odd obstacles from real roads, but can't blindly upload every frame (bandwidth/storage blow up).
q: 怎样高效地从车队采到更多罕见帧?
q_en: How do you efficiently collect more rare frames from the fleet?
why: 触发式采集把带宽花在刀刃上:平时不传,只有车载启发式命中异常(急刹、异形、低能见度)时才高清抓拍,直接放大尾部。全量回传成本爆炸,随机抽样又抽不到罕见类。
why_en: Trigger-based capture spends bandwidth only when onboard heuristics flag anomalies like hard braking or low visibility, directly amplifying the tail instead of logging everything.
tradeoff: 触发式采集(省带宽、命中尾部) vs 全量回传(覆盖全但成本爆炸)
options: 全车队 24 小时高清回传所有帧,事后再筛
触发式采集:车载启发式检测到异常(急刹、异形、低能见度)时才高清抓取上传
只在数据中心用随机采样从历史日志里抽帧
只靠合成数据,完全不从真实车队采集
options_en: Have the whole fleet upload every frame in high-res 24/7, then filter afterward.
Trigger-based capture: only grab and upload high-res when onboard heuristics detect anomalies (hard braking, odd shapes, low visibility).
Only random-sample frames from historical logs in the data center.
Rely on synthetic data alone and never collect from the real fleet.
whenOtherWins: 若某类罕见场景连车载启发式都无法在线识别(没有可靠触发信号),那就得靠离线主动学习或合成数据来补,而非触发式采集。
optionExplanations: 全量高清回传带宽和存储都撑不住,而且回来的还是 95% 常规帧,筛选成本极高。
对;触发式只在异常命中时抓拍,把有限带宽花在尾部帧上,是主动获取的正解。
随机抽历史日志抽到的仍按真实频率,几乎全是常规帧,救不了罕见类稀缺。
合成能补一部分,但完全不采真实数据会漏掉真实传感器特性和真实罕见分布。
optionExplanations_en: Full high-res upload overwhelms bandwidth and storage, and returns 95% routine frames anyway, making filtering hugely costly.
Correct — capturing only on anomaly triggers spends limited bandwidth on tail frames, the right active-acquisition move.
Random-sampling logs still follows real frequency, nearly all routine frames, and can't fix rare-class scarcity.
Synthetic fills some gaps, but never collecting real data misses real sensor characteristics and the real rare distribution.

termDefinitions.meaning: 车载启发式命中异常(急刹、异形、低能见度)时才高清抓拍上传,而非全量回传。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Trigger-based capture uploads high-res only when onboard heuristics flag anomalies like hard braking or low visibility, not everything.

termDefinitions.meaning: 有目的地去采集稀缺样本,而非被动等它自然出现。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Active acquisition deliberately goes after scarce samples instead of passively waiting for them to appear.

q: 尺度感知增强(scale-aware augmentation)里的 mosaic、尺度抖动为什么要"校准",不能随便做?
q_en: Why must mosaic and scale jitter in scale-aware augmentation be 'calibrated' rather than arbitrary?
why: 尺度感知增强用随机裁剪、尺度抖动、mosaic 造多尺度样本,但要校准到真实距离尺寸——远处行人本就小、近处大;若尺度乱来,模型学到不真实的尺寸分布,反而在真实测距/检测上退化。
why_en: Scale-aware augmentation uses random crop, scale jitter, and mosaic for multi-scale samples, calibrated to realistic distances so the model detects both small far and large near pedestrians.
options: 保持物体在不同距离的真实尺寸,让模型能检测远处小行人和近处大行人
只是为了让图片更好看,校准与否不影响精度
校准是为了压缩图像体积、加快训练 IO
目的是把所有物体缩放到同一固定像素大小
options_en: To keep objects at realistic sizes for their distance, so the model detects both small far pedestrians and large near ones.
Just to make images look nicer; calibration doesn't affect accuracy.
Calibration is to shrink image size and speed up training IO.
The goal is to scale every object to one fixed pixel size.
optionExplanations: 对;校准保持真实的"远小近大"尺寸分布,模型才能同时学会检测远处小目标和近处大目标。
增强直接改变训练分布,校准与否直接影响精度,不是美观问题。
尺度增强目的是多尺度鲁棒性,不是压缩体积或加速 IO。
把所有物体缩到同一尺寸会抹掉尺度信息,和"检测各种距离目标"的目标相反。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — calibration preserves the real small-far/large-near size distribution so the model learns both far small and near large objects.
Augmentation directly changes the training distribution, so calibration affects accuracy; it's not about looks.
Scale augmentation aims at multi-scale robustness, not shrinking size or speeding IO.
Scaling everything to one size erases scale info, the opposite of detecting objects at various distances.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时随机缩放图像/目标,制造多尺度样本以提升尺度鲁棒性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Scale jitter randomly rescales images or objects during training to create multi-scale samples for scale robustness.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把多张图拼成一张,增加一张样本里的尺度与上下文多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Mosaic augmentation stitches multiple images into one, adding scale and context diversity within a single sample.

q: 用什么方法在最小预算下选出"有信息量又多样"的罕见样本?
q_en: Which method picks 'informative and diverse' rare samples on a minimal budget?
why: 子模函数有"边际递减"性质:已选相似样本后,再选一个几乎相似的收益很小。子模互信息(SMI)据此挑子集,自动兼顾信息量和多样性,用最小预算覆盖罕见样本。
why_en: Submodularity has diminishing returns, so submodular mutual information picks a subset that maximizes information and diversity together, covering rare samples on a minimal budget.
tradeoff: 子模选择(信息量+多样性,省预算) vs 随机抽样(简单但重复且漏罕见)
options: 随机抽样:实现简单、无选择偏差,按真实频率取帧
只选模型置信度最高的帧,认为这样标注质量最有保证
按采集时间顺序,取最新的一批帧来标注
子模选择:用子模互信息(SMI)挑兼顾信息量与多样性的子集
options_en: Random sampling — simple, no selection bias, drawing frames at real frequency.
Pick only the model's highest-confidence frames, assuming that best ensures label quality.
Take the most recent batch of frames by capture time to label.
Submodular selection: SMI picks a subset balancing information and diversity.
whenOtherWins: 若预算充足或样本池本身已很多样,随机抽样更省事;子模选择的价值在预算紧、且要避免重复选到相似样本时才凸显。
optionExplanations: 随机抽样按真实频率走,罕见类几乎抽不到,还会重复选到相似样本,浪费预算。
只选高置信帧等于挑模型已会的样本,信息量最低,恰恰不该优先标。
取最新帧是时间偏好,和"信息量+多样性"无关,可能全是相似场景。
对;SMI 利用边际递减自动避开冗余,挑出既有信息量又多样的一小批,最省预算。
optionExplanations_en: Random sampling follows real frequency, barely hitting rare classes and repeatedly picking similar samples, wasting budget.
Only high-confidence frames are ones the model already knows, the least informative, exactly what not to label first.
Newest frames is a time preference unrelated to information/diversity and may be all similar scenes.
Correct — SMI uses diminishing returns to avoid redundancy, picking a small informative and diverse batch most budget-efficiently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 子模互信息:利用边际递减性质选样本子集,同时最大化信息量与多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SMI (Submodular Mutual Information) uses the diminishing-returns property to pick a sample subset maximizing information and diversity together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 已选相似样本后,再加一个高度相似的样本带来的额外收益迅速变小。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Diminishing returns means once similar samples are chosen, adding another highly similar one yields rapidly shrinking extra value.

scenario: 团队用无约束的仿射变换(平移、旋转、缩放)大量增强行人样本,验证集 mAP 看着不错。
scenario_en: The team heavily augments pedestrian samples with unconstrained affine transforms (translate, rotate, scale); validation mAP looks fine.
q: 无约束仿射增强的风险是什么,怎么缓解?
q_en: What's the risk of unconstrained affine augmentation, and how do you mitigate it?
why: 无约束仿射变换会把行人放到不可能的位置(悬在路面上方、穿墙),模型学到不真实分布,真实场景反而退化。缓解:约束变换范围,校验增强帧物理可信(行人应在地面、尺寸随距离合理)。
why_en: Unconstrained affine transforms can float a pedestrian above the road, teaching an unreal distribution that hurts robustness, so you validate that augmented frames are physically plausible.
tradeoff: 多增强(样本更多) vs 物理不可信样本(损害真实场景鲁棒性)
options: 没有风险,增强越多越好,直接全量上
风险是训练变慢,缓解办法是减少增强数量
会生成物理不可能的样本(行人悬空),损害鲁棒性;要校验增强帧物理可信
风险是标签丢失,缓解办法是重新人工标注每张增强图
options_en: No risk; more augmentation is always better, so apply it all.
The risk is slower training; mitigate by reducing the amount of augmentation.
It can generate physically impossible samples (a pedestrian floating above the road), hurting robustness; validate that augmented frames are physically plausible.
The risk is lost labels; mitigate by re-annotating every augmented image by hand.
optionExplanations: 验证集 mAP 好只是假象:不可信样本让模型学偏,真实路况会掉,不能"越多越好"。
训练慢不是核心风险,核心是分布被污染;单纯减量不解决物理不可信的问题。
对;悬空/穿墙这类样本教给模型错误先验,得靠约束变换+物理可信性校验挡住。
仿射变换会同步搬运标签,通常不丢标签;重标每张图既不必要也不解决物理不可信。
optionExplanations_en: Good validation mAP is an illusion: implausible samples mislead the model and it drops on real roads, so 'more is better' fails.
Slower training isn't the core risk; the core is a polluted distribution, and just reducing amount doesn't fix implausibility.
Correct — floating/through-wall samples teach a wrong prior, so you constrain transforms and validate physical plausibility.
Affine transforms move labels along, so labels usually aren't lost; re-annotating every image is needless and doesn't fix implausibility.

termDefinitions.meaning: 平移、旋转、缩放、错切等线性几何变换;无约束时可能造出不真实构图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An affine transform is a linear geometric operation (translate, rotate, scale, shear); unconstrained it can produce unrealistic compositions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测常用指标:对各类别的平均精度再取均值,越高越好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) is a standard detection metric averaging per-class average precision; higher is better.

q: 把长尾数据飞轮排成正确的循环顺序:
q_en: Order the long-tail data flywheel into its correct loop:
steps: 标注后扩大尾部覆盖,重训模型
车载触发器捕获异常场景(急刹、异形、低能见度)
更强的模型部署回车队,更会识别新异常
why: 飞轮:车载触发采集→标注队列→扩大尾部覆盖重训→更强模型回车队→触发器更会识别新异常,循环往复。每转一圈尾部覆盖变宽、模型变强,是长尾持续改进的引擎。
why_en: The flywheel loops trigger-capture to annotation queue to a retrained model with wider tail coverage to a stronger fleet that flags new anomalies, each turn widening the tail.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  T["车载触发捕获异常"] --> Q["标注队列"]
  Q --> R["重训扩大尾部覆盖"]
  R --> M["更强模型回车队"]
  M --> T

termDefinitions.meaning: 触发采集→标注→重训→更强模型→触发更准的自我强化循环,越转尾部覆盖越宽。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A data flywheel is the self-reinforcing loop of trigger-capture to labeling to retraining to a stronger model, widening tail coverage each turn.

q: 为什么安全关键检测需要合成数据/仿真,而不能只靠真实采集?
q_en: Why does safety-critical detection need synthetic data/simulation, not just real capture?
why: 真实世界里你不能为了采数据去制造碰撞、让儿童冲出马路或等极端天气;合成/仿真能安全地生成这些不可采集的场景,还自带完美 ground truth。它是补不可采集尾部的手段,不是省钱噱头。
why_en: You can't ethically stage real collisions, child-darting, or extreme weather, so simulation safely generates these uncollectable scenes with perfect ground truth.
options: 有些场景不能在真实世界伦理地制造——真实碰撞、儿童冲出、极端天气——只能在仿真里生成
因为真实数据永远比合成数据便宜,合成只是省钱手段
因为合成数据没有域差(domain gap),可直接替代真实数据
因为真实相机分辨率不够,只有仿真能生成高清图
options_en: Some scenes can't be ethically staged in the real world — real collisions, child-darting, extreme weather — so they can only be generated in simulation.
Because real data is always cheaper than synthetic, so synthetic is just a cost-saving trick.
Because synthetic data has no domain gap and can directly replace real data.
Because real cameras lack resolution and only simulation can produce high-res images.
optionExplanations: 对;不可伦理制造的碰撞/儿童冲出/极端天气正是合成的独特价值,补的是采不到的尾部。
省钱不是主因,而且真实数据未必更贵;合成的核心价值在生成不可采集场景。
恰恰相反:域差是合成的头号风险,所以它是补充而非直接替代真实数据。
真实相机分辨率通常够;问题不在清晰度,而在某些场景不能真实制造。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — collisions, child-darting, and extreme weather that can't be ethically staged are synthetic's unique value, filling the uncollectable tail.
Cost isn't the main reason and real data isn't necessarily pricier; synthetic's core value is generating uncollectable scenes.
The opposite — the domain gap is synthetic's top risk, so it complements rather than directly replaces real data.
Real cameras usually have enough resolution; the issue isn't sharpness but that some scenes can't be staged for real.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被当作正确答案的标注;仿真里每个物体位置已知,真值天然免费且完美。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ground truth is the annotation treated as correct; in simulation every object's position is known, so it's free and perfect.

termDefinitions.meaning: 合成数据与真实数据的分布差异,导致纯合成训练的模型在真实数据上掉点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The domain gap is the distribution difference between synthetic and real data that makes purely synthetic-trained models drop on real data.

q: CARLA、NVIDIA DRIVE Sim 这类仿真器的核心优势是什么?
q_en: What's the core advantage of simulators like CARLA and NVIDIA DRIVE Sim?
why: 仿真器逐帧渲染都知道每个物体的精确位置,所以 ground truth 免费、边际标注成本为零;更关键的是能系统性扫参——把时间、天气、行人行为、遮挡当旋钮遍历,快速造出真实里罕见的组合。
why_en: Simulators render every object with a known position, so ground truth is free at zero marginal cost, and you can systematically sweep time, weather, behavior, and occlusion.
options: 生成的图像与真实传感器完全一致,没有任何域差
逼真场景+完美真值,零边际标注成本,还能系统性扫参(时间/天气/行为/遮挡)
能直接替代所有真实数据,把训练成本降到零
只能生成晴天白天的简单场景,不支持天气变化
options_en: The images exactly match real sensors, with no domain gap at all.
Photorealistic scenes with perfect ground truth at zero marginal labeling cost, plus a systematic parameter sweep (time/weather/behavior/occlusion).
It can directly replace all real data and drop training cost to zero.
It can only render simple sunny daytime scenes and doesn't support weather changes.
optionExplanations: 不成立:合成与真实仍有域差,这正是它不能直接替代真实数据的原因。
对;免费完美真值+系统性扫参是仿真的两大杀手锏,能快速覆盖真实里罕见的组合。
夸大了:域差在,合成只能补充(safety-critical 约 10-30%),不能全替代。
反了:CARLA/DRIVE Sim 恰恰擅长遍历天气、时间、行为等参数。
optionExplanations_en: Not true — synthetic still differs from real, which is exactly why it can't directly replace real data.
Correct — free perfect ground truth plus systematic parameter sweep are the two killer features, quickly covering combos rare in reality.
Overstated — the domain gap remains, so synthetic only supplements (about 10-30% for safety-critical), not full replacement.
Backwards — CARLA/DRIVE Sim are precisely built to sweep weather, time, and behavior.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开源自动驾驶仿真器,生成逼真带真值的驾驶场景用于训练/测试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CARLA (Car Learning to Act) is an open-source driving simulator that generates photorealistic scenes with ground truth for training and testing.

termDefinitions.meaning: 英伟达的自动驾驶仿真平台,可批量生成带完美标注的合成传感器数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NVIDIA DRIVE Sim is a driving simulation platform that mass-produces synthetic sensor data with perfect labels.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把时间、天气、行为、遮挡等当旋钮系统性遍历,快速造出各种场景组合。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A parameter sweep systematically varies knobs like time, weather, behavior, and occlusion to generate many scene combinations fast.

scenario: 用纯合成数据训练的检测器在仿真验证集上 mAP 很高,一上真实路测就掉。
scenario_en: A detector trained on purely synthetic data has high mAP on the synthetic validation set but drops on real road tests.
q: 这个现象叫什么,根因是什么?
q_en: What is this phenomenon called, and what's its root cause?
why: 这是域差:合成图像的纹理、光照、噪声分布和真实传感器不同,模型可能学到渲染伪影而非真实特征,一换到真实分布就掉点。它是合成数据的头号风险,必须靠域随机化/域自适应缩小。
why_en: This is the domain gap: synthetic rendering differs from real sensor statistics, so the model latches onto rendering artifacts and drops on real data.
diagram:
flowchart LR S["纯合成训练"] --> V["合成验证 mAP 高"] S --> RT["真实路测 mAP 掉"] RT --> G["域差
特征分布不匹配"]
options: 过拟合导致,只要增大合成数据量即可解决
标签噪声导致,重新标注合成数据即可修复
域差:合成渲染与真实传感器特征分布不匹配,模型学到渲染伪影
欠拟合导致,把网络加深加宽就能修
options_en: Overfitting, fixable by increasing the amount of synthetic data.
Label noise, fixable by re-annotating the synthetic data.
The domain gap: a feature-distribution mismatch between synthetic rendering and real sensors, so the model learned rendering artifacts.
Underfitting, fixable by deepening the network.
optionExplanations: 不是过拟合:模型在合成验证上也好,问题是合成与真实分布不同,加更多合成数据只会强化错误特征。
合成数据真值是完美的,不存在标签噪声;掉点来自分布差异不是标错。
对;域差=合成渲染与真实传感器特征分布不匹配,模型学了渲染伪影,换真实分布就掉。
不是欠拟合:合成验证 mAP 很高说明拟合充分,问题在跨域泛化。
optionExplanations_en: Not overfitting — the model is good on synthetic val too; the issue is synthetic vs real distributions, and more synthetic just reinforces wrong features.
Synthetic ground truth is perfect, so there's no label noise; the drop comes from distribution mismatch, not mislabels.
Correct — the domain gap is a feature-distribution mismatch between synthetic rendering and real sensors, so the model learned artifacts and drops on real.
Not underfitting — high synthetic-val mAP shows it fits fine; the issue is cross-domain generalization.

termDefinitions.meaning: 合成与真实数据的分布差异;纯合成训练在真实数据上掉点的根因。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The domain gap is the distribution difference between synthetic and real data, the reason purely synthetic training drops on real data.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检测精度指标:各类别平均精度再取均值,越高越好。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: mAP (mean Average Precision) averages per-class average precision as a detection accuracy metric; higher is better.

q: 缩小域差的域随机化 vs 域自适应怎么分工?
q_en: How do domain randomization and domain adaptation divide the work of closing the domain gap?
why: 域随机化在合成端猛加视觉变化(纹理、光照、相机噪声),逼模型学变化无关的不变特征;域自适应反过来用风格迁移让合成帧看起来像真实传感器数据。一个"加噪变宽"、一个"贴近真实",互补使用。
why_en: Domain randomization widens synthetic visual variation so the model learns invariant features, while domain adaptation uses style transfer to make synthetic look real — complementary approaches.
tradeoff: 域随机化(加大变化学不变特征) vs 域自适应(把合成分布贴近真实)
options: 两者都是加大合成数据量的别名,本质相同
域随机化靠人工重标,域自适应靠增大模型
域自适应随机化纹理光照;域随机化做风格迁移
域随机化随机化视觉参数学不变特征;域自适应用风格迁移贴近真实,互补
options_en: Both are aliases for adding more synthetic data and are essentially the same.
Domain randomization relies on human re-labeling; domain adaptation on a bigger model.
Domain adaptation randomizes textures and lighting; domain randomization does style transfer.
Domain randomization randomizes visual params so the model learns invariant features; domain adaptation uses style transfer to make synthetic look real — complementary.
optionExplanations: 两者是缩域差的不同机制,不是"加数据量"的别名,混为一谈会错过它们的互补性。
都不涉及人工重标或单纯加大模型;它们改的是数据分布,不是靠人力或容量。
说反了:随机纹理光照是域随机化;风格迁移是域自适应。
对;一个在合成端加大变化学不变特征,一个把合成风格拉近真实,常一起用。
optionExplanations_en: They're different gap-closing mechanisms, not aliases for 'more data', and conflating them misses their complementarity.
Neither involves human re-labeling or just a bigger model; they change the data distribution, not via headcount or capacity.
Backwards — randomizing textures/lighting is domain randomization; style transfer is domain adaptation.
Correct — one widens synthetic variation for invariant features, the other pulls synthetic style toward real, often used together.

termDefinitions.meaning: 随机化纹理、光照、相机噪声等视觉参数,逼模型学与渲染无关的不变特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain randomization randomizes visual params like textures, lighting, and camera noise so the model learns rendering-invariant features.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用风格迁移等手段让合成帧在特征上贴近真实传感器数据,从另一端缩小域差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Domain adaptation uses techniques like style transfer to make synthetic frames resemble real sensor data, closing the gap from the other side.

termDefinitions.meaning: 保留内容、换上目标域外观的技术,这里把合成帧改造得像真实传感器画面。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Style transfer keeps content but restyles appearance to a target domain, here making synthetic frames look like real sensor images.

scenario: 要决定安全关键类别的训练数据里,合成数据该占多大比例。
scenario_en: You must decide what fraction of training data for safety-critical classes should be synthetic.
q: 行业上合成数据在安全关键类别里的典型占比与定位是什么?
q_en: What's the typical synthetic share and role for safety-critical classes in industry?
why: 行业用合成补充安全关键类别训练的约 10-30%,真实数据仍是主干。这不是公式而是经验区间,定位是"补充不可采集的尾部",不是替代——比例越高越放大域差,所以保守起步、在真实验证集上测尾部类 mAP。
why_en: Industry supplements about 10-30% of safety-critical training with synthetic while real data stays the backbone; it's an empirical range framing synthetic as a complement, not a replacement.
options: 80-90%,合成便宜,应尽量多用、真实数据只留少量点缀
50/50 固定对半,是所有任务的最优比例
约 10-30% 用于补充安全关键类别,真实数据仍是主干,合成是补充不是替代
0%,合成数据有域差,永远不该用于安全关键类别
options_en: 80-90% — synthetic is cheap, so use as much as possible with only a sprinkle of real data.
A fixed 50/50 split, the optimal ratio for all tasks.
About 10-30% to supplement safety-critical classes, with real data as the backbone — synthetic complements, not replaces.
0% — synthetic has a domain gap and should never be used for safety-critical classes.

termDefinitions.term: synthetic supplement ratio 合成补充比例
termDefinitions.meaning: 合成数据占训练数据的比例;安全关键类别经验区间约 10-30%,真实数据为主干。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The synthetic supplement ratio is synthetic's share of training data; for safety-critical classes it's empirically about 10-30% with real data as the backbone.

scenario: 有人主张把安全关键类别的合成数据占比拉到 50% 以上,好"快速补齐罕见类"。
scenario_en: Someone argues pushing synthetic above 50% for safety-critical classes to 'quickly fill rare classes'.
q: 把合成占比拉高到 >30% 有什么风险,该怎么做?
q_en: What's the risk of pushing synthetic above 30%, and what should you do?
why: 占比 >30% 会放大域差:合成越多,模型越可能拟合渲染伪影,除非配合激进的域随机化/自适应。做法是保守起步,并在真实验证集上测尾部类 mAP,用真实指标决定能否加比例。
why_en: Above 30% amplifies the domain gap unless paired with aggressive randomization/adaptation, so start conservative and measure tail-class mAP on real validation.
tradeoff: 高合成占比(快速补罕见类) vs 放大域差(真实上掉点,除非激进域适配)
options: 没风险,合成占比越高越好,能最快补齐罕见类
唯一风险是训练变慢,和域差、真实精度无关
会放大域差,除非配激进域随机化/自适应;应保守起步,在真实验证集测尾部类 mAP
风险是合成数据太贵,应改回纯真实数据、彻底放弃合成
options_en: No risk; the higher the synthetic share the better, filling rare classes fastest.
The only risk is slower training, unrelated to the domain gap or real accuracy.
It amplifies the domain gap unless you use aggressive randomization/adaptation; start conservative and measure tail-class mAP on real validation.
The risk is synthetic being too expensive, so revert to pure real data and drop synthetic entirely.
optionExplanations: 占比越高越放大域差,真实上会掉点,不是"越高越好"。
训练速度不是核心;核心风险是域差被放大、真实精度下降。
对;>30% 放大域差,必须配激进域适配,并以真实验证集尾部类 mAP 为准绳保守加比例。
合成通常更便宜,不是成本问题;彻底放弃合成又丢了补不可采集尾部的能力。
optionExplanations_en: A higher share amplifies the domain gap and drops real accuracy, so 'higher is better' is wrong.
Training speed isn't the core; the core risk is an amplified domain gap and falling real accuracy.
Correct — above 30% amplifies the gap, so pair with aggressive adaptation and gate increases on real-validation tail-class mAP.
Synthetic is usually cheaper, so it's not a cost issue, and dropping it entirely loses the ability to fill the uncollectable tail.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只在罕见/安全关键类别上算的 mAP,是检验合成是否真帮到长尾的指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Tail-class mAP is mAP computed only on rare/safety-critical classes, the metric that checks whether synthetic actually helps the long tail.

scenario: 3D 点云标注约 5-10 美元/帧,面对数百万帧,全标预算爆炸,但又要保住安全关键类的 mAP。
scenario_en: 3D point-cloud labeling costs ~$5-10/frame across millions of frames; labeling all blows the budget, but you must keep safety-critical mAP.
q: 怎么在有限预算下决定优先标哪些帧?
q_en: How do you decide which frames to label first under a limited budget?
why: 3D 点云每帧 5-10 美元 × 数百万帧,全标不现实,所以只标最有信息量的帧。主动学习用 acquisition function 从大池子里挑出模型最不确定或最不同的帧优先标,用最小标注量换最大精度提升。
why_en: At $5-10/frame across millions, labeling all is infeasible, so active learning uses an acquisition function to pick the most informative frames, buying the most accuracy per label.
tradeoff: 主动学习(只标最有信息量帧,省 30-50%) vs 全标/随机标(覆盖全但预算爆炸)
options: 把预算平均摊到所有帧,随机抽一部分来标
主动学习:让采集函数(acquisition)按信息量给帧打分,优先标高分帧
只标模型已经很确定的帧,保证标注质量高
干脆不标 3D 点云,只用免费的 2D 框凑合
options_en: Spread the budget evenly and randomly sample a subset of frames to label.
Active learning: let an acquisition function score frames by informativeness and label the top ones first.
Only label frames the model is already confident on, to keep label quality high.
Skip 3D point clouds entirely and make do with free 2D boxes.
whenOtherWins: 若未标注池本身就小、或标注很便宜,随机全标更简单;主动学习的价值在预算紧、单帧标注贵(如 3D 点云)时才凸显。
optionExplanations: 随机抽按真实频率走,大多是模型已会的常规帧,信息量低、浪费昂贵的 3D 标注预算。
对;采集函数按信息量给帧打分,把有限预算投到最能提升精度的样本上。
标已确定的帧信息增益几乎为零——模型本来就会,等于花钱买没用的标注。
放弃 3D 点云就丢了融合测距/轨迹能力,安全关键类的 mAP 保不住。
optionExplanations_en: Random sampling follows real frequency, mostly frames the model already knows, low-information and wasting costly 3D budget.
Correct — the acquisition function picks the most uncertain/different frames, spending limited budget where accuracy gains are largest.
Labeling confident frames yields near-zero information gain — the model already knows them, so you pay for useless labels.
Dropping 3D point clouds loses fusion distance/trajectory, and safety-critical mAP can't be held.

termDefinitions.meaning: 让模型挑出最有信息量的样本优先标注,以最小标注量换最大精度提升。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Active learning lets the model pick the most informative samples to label first, buying the most accuracy per label.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给每个未标注样本打分、决定优先标谁的准则,如不确定性或多样性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An acquisition function scores each unlabeled sample to decide labeling priority, e.g., by uncertainty or diversity.

q: 把主动学习循环排成正确顺序:
q_en: Order the active-learning loop correctly:
steps: 在大规模未标注池上推理
acquisition function 选出最有信息量的帧
在种子集(seed set)上训练模型
人工标注选中的帧,并入训练集重训
why: 主动学习循环:先用种子集训练→在未标注池上推理→acquisition function 选最有信息量的帧→人工标注并入重训,再回到推理。每转一圈只标最该标的帧,预算利用率最高。
why_en: The loop trains on a seed set, infers on the unlabeled pool, has the acquisition function pick the most informative frames, then labels and retrains, maximizing budget efficiency each turn.

flowchart LR
  A["种子集训练"] --> B["未标注池推理"]
  B --> C["acquisition 选信息量最大帧"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 主动学习起步用的一小批已标注数据,用来训练首个模型再去挑样本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A seed set is the small initial labeled batch used to train the first model before it selects samples.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给未标注样本打分、决定优先标谁的准则(不确定性/多样性/混合)。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An acquisition function scores unlabeled samples to decide labeling priority (uncertainty, diversity, or hybrid).

q: 主动学习里的不确定性采样(uncertainty sampling)选哪些帧?
q_en: Which frames does uncertainty sampling pick in active learning?
why: 不确定性采样挑模型置信度最低的帧——比如"行人"只给 0.52 的帧比给 0.99 的更该标。低置信往往意味着模型没见过或拿不准,标了信息增益最大。
why_en: Uncertainty sampling picks the lowest-confidence frames — a 0.52 'pedestrian' beats a 0.99 one — because low confidence means high information gain if labeled.
options: 模型置信度最低的帧(0.52 比 0.99 更该标),信息增益最大
模型置信度最高的帧,确保标注不出错
与训练集差异最大的帧,覆盖没见过的条件
随机抽取的帧,认为这样能避免任何选择偏差
options_en: The lowest-confidence frames (a 0.52 'pedestrian' over a 0.99 one) because information gain is highest.
The highest-confidence frames to make sure labeling has no errors.
The frames most different from the training set to cover unseen conditions.
Randomly sampled frames to avoid any selection bias.
optionExplanations: 对;低置信帧是模型拿不准的,标了信息增益最大,0.52 比 0.99 更值得优先标。
高置信帧模型本来就会,信息增益接近零,标它是浪费预算。
那是多样性采样的判据(与训练集最不同),不是不确定性采样。
随机抽不看模型状态,信息量偏低,正是主动学习要超越的基线。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — low-confidence frames are ones the model is unsure about, giving the highest information gain, so 0.52 beats 0.99.
High-confidence frames are ones the model already knows, near-zero information gain, so labeling them wastes budget.
That's the diversity-sampling criterion (most different from the training set), not uncertainty sampling.
Random sampling ignores model state, giving lower information, the baseline active learning aims to beat.

termDefinitions.term: uncertainty sampling 不确定性采样
termDefinitions.meaning: 优先标注模型置信度最低的样本,因为它们信息增益最大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Uncertainty sampling prioritizes labeling the model's lowest-confidence samples because they carry the most information gain.

q: 多样性采样(diversity sampling)按什么标准选帧,解决什么问题?
q_en: By what criterion does diversity sampling pick frames, and what problem does it solve?
why: 多样性采样挑与训练集最不相似的帧,覆盖欠代表的条件——雾天、眩光、奇怪视角。它防止只盯着一类难例,把标注预算摊到没见过的场景上,补的是覆盖面。
why_en: Diversity sampling picks frames most dissimilar to the training set to cover underrepresented conditions like fog, glare, and odd angles, spreading budget across unseen scenes.
options: 选置信度最低的帧,专攻模型最拿不准的样本
选与训练集最不相似的帧,覆盖欠代表条件(雾天、眩光、奇怪视角)
选置信度最高的帧,巩固模型已学会的场景
按拍摄时间顺序选最新的帧
options_en: Pick the lowest-confidence frames to focus on what the model is most unsure about.
Pick frames most dissimilar to the training set to cover underrepresented conditions (fog, glare, odd angles).
Pick the highest-confidence frames to reinforce scenes the model already knows.
Pick the newest frames in capture-time order.
optionExplanations: 那是不确定性采样的判据(最低置信),不是多样性采样看的"与训练集差异"。
对;多样性采样按与训练集的差异挑帧,专门补雾天/眩光/奇角这类欠代表条件。
选高置信帧巩固已学会的,和多样性"补没见过的"目标相反。
按时间选是时间偏好,和覆盖多样条件无关,可能全是相似场景。
optionExplanations_en: That's the uncertainty-sampling criterion (lowest confidence), not diversity's 'difference from the training set'.
Correct — diversity sampling picks by dissimilarity to the training set, specifically covering underrepresented conditions like fog, glare, odd angles.
Picking high-confidence frames reinforces the known, opposite to diversity's goal of covering the unseen.
Time-order selection is a time preference unrelated to covering diverse conditions and may be all similar scenes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 优先标注与训练集最不相似的样本,补齐欠代表的条件和场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Diversity sampling prioritizes samples most unlike the training set, filling underrepresented conditions and scenes.

scenario: 只用不确定性采样时,模型反复挑到一堆彼此相似的难例(同一种雾天场景),预算被重复样本吃掉。
scenario_en: With uncertainty sampling alone, the model repeatedly picks a cluster of similar hard cases (the same foggy scene), and budget is eaten by redundancy.
q: 混合采集(hybrid)相比单用不确定性采样好在哪?
q_en: How is hybrid acquisition better than uncertainty sampling alone?
why: 单用不确定性会反复挑到相似难例,冗余浪费预算;混合把不确定性和多样性结合,既挑模型拿不准的,又保证彼此不相似,得到"有信息量又不冗余"的一批。
why_en: Uncertainty alone repeatedly picks similar hard cases and wastes budget on redundancy; hybrid combines uncertainty with diversity for informative and non-redundant samples.
tradeoff: 混合(信息量+多样性,不冗余) vs 纯不确定性(信息量高但可能扎堆相似难例)
options: 混合更快,因为它跳过推理直接选帧
混合只用多样性,彻底放弃不确定性
混合无需 acquisition function,随机选即可
混合结合不确定性+多样性,既挑拿不准的又保证不相似,避免反复选相似难例
options_en: Hybrid is faster because it skips inference and picks frames directly.
Hybrid uses only diversity and drops uncertainty entirely.
Hybrid needs no acquisition function; random selection is enough.
Hybrid combines uncertainty + diversity, picking uncertain yet dissimilar frames, avoiding repeatedly selecting similar hard cases.
optionExplanations: 混合仍要在池上推理拿置信度,并不跳过推理,也不以"更快"取胜。
只用多样性会丢掉"挑模型拿不准"的价值;混合是两者结合,不是二选一。
混合恰恰需要 acquisition function 同时算不确定性和多样性,不是随机。
对;混合兼顾信息量和多样性,专治不确定性单用时扎堆相似难例的冗余问题。
optionExplanations_en: Hybrid still infers on the pool to get confidences, so it doesn't skip inference or win on 'faster'.
Diversity-only loses the value of picking the model's uncertain cases; hybrid combines both, not either-or.
Hybrid specifically needs an acquisition function computing both uncertainty and diversity, not random selection.
Correct — hybrid balances information and diversity, fixing the redundancy of uncertainty-only clustering on similar hard cases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时用不确定性和多样性挑样本,兼顾信息量与非冗余。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hybrid acquisition uses both uncertainty and diversity to select samples, balancing information gain and non-redundancy.

q: 为什么主动学习能在没有专门触发工程的情况下"顺手"挖出长尾样本?
q_en: Why does active learning surface long-tail samples 'for free' without dedicated trigger engineering?
why: 模型不确定的检测往往正是罕见/新奇物体——因为训练里没见过所以拿不准。所以不确定性采样天然把这些尾部样本浮上来,不必像触发式采集那样专门写启发式规则。
why_en: Uncertain detections are often rare or novel objects the model hasn't seen, so uncertainty sampling naturally surfaces tail samples without hand-written triggers.
options: 因为主动学习会随机遍历所有帧,总会碰到罕见样本
因为它只挑高置信帧,而罕见物体恰好置信度高
因为模型不确定的检测往往就是罕见/新奇物体,不确定性采样自然把尾部浮出来
因为它需要人工先写好触发规则,才知道罕见样本在哪
options_en: Because active learning randomly scans all frames and always stumbles on rare samples.
Because it only picks high-confidence frames, and rare objects happen to be high-confidence.
Because uncertain detections are often rare or novel objects, so uncertainty sampling naturally surfaces the tail.
Because it first needs hand-written trigger rules to know where rare samples are.
optionExplanations: 主动学习不是随机遍历,而是按信息量选;随机反而抽不到罕见类。
反了:罕见物体模型没见过、置信度低,不是高置信。
对;没见过的物体让模型犯难,低置信即信号,不确定性采样顺手把尾部捞出来,省了触发工程。
恰相反:主动学习不用手写触发规则,靠模型不确定性自动发现罕见样本。
optionExplanations_en: Active learning isn't a random scan but an information-driven pick; random would miss rare classes.
Backwards — rare objects the model hasn't seen are low-confidence, not high.
Correct — unseen objects stump the model, low confidence is the signal, and uncertainty sampling scoops the tail for free.
The opposite — active learning needs no hand-written triggers; model uncertainty discovers rare samples automatically.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练分布外、模型没见过的物体,通常表现为低置信度检测。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A novel object is one outside the training distribution the model hasn't seen, usually showing up as a low-confidence detection.

scenario: 标注预算有限,各安全关键类别的当前 mAP 不一样:行人 0.82、轮椅使用者 0.61、路面碎片 0.55。
scenario_en: Labeling budget is limited and safety-critical classes have different current mAP: pedestrian 0.82, wheelchair user 0.61, road debris 0.55.
q: Staff+ 会怎么在这些类之间分配标注预算?
q_en: How would a Staff+ engineer allocate labeling budget across these classes?
why: Staff+ 把标注预算按"最低尾部类 mAP"倾斜:哪个安全关键类最弱(路面碎片 0.55),就优先给它加标注/主动采集。这样预算跟着最大安全短板走,而不是平均撒或投给已经很好的类。
why_en: Staff+ allocates budget proportional to the lowest tail-class mAP, pouring labels into the weakest safety-critical class first rather than spreading evenly.
tradeoff: 按最低尾部类 mAP 倾斜(补最大安全短板) vs 平均分配(短板依旧漏检)
options: 平均分给三类,保证公平,每类都加一样多
优先投给 mAP 最高的行人(0.82),巩固已有优势
优先投给 mAP 最低的路面碎片(0.55),预算按最低尾部类倾斜补安全短板
只投给样本量最大的类,数据多才好训
options_en: Split evenly across the three classes for fairness, adding the same to each.
Prioritize the highest-mAP pedestrian (0.82) to consolidate the existing strength.
Prioritize the lowest-mAP road debris (0.55), skewing budget to the weakest tail class to fix the biggest safety gap.
Invest only in the class with the most samples, since more data trains better.
whenOtherWins: 若某个低 mAP 类的瓶颈不是数据量而是标注定义或标签噪声,那先修标注规范比继续砸预算更有效。
optionExplanations: 平均分配让最弱的碎片类依旧漏检,安全短板没补上,不是按风险分配。
行人已 0.82,边际收益小;把钱花在已经好的类上,最危险的短板反而没管。
对;预算跟着最低尾部类 mAP 走,先补路面碎片这个最大安全短板,风险下降最快。
样本最多的类往往已经够好;按样本量分配和"补最弱安全类"的目标不一致。
optionExplanations_en: Even splitting leaves the weakest debris class still missed, the safety gap unfilled — not risk-based allocation.
Pedestrian is already 0.82 with small marginal gains; spending on the strong class leaves the most dangerous gap unaddressed.
Correct — budget follows the lowest tail-class mAP, fixing road debris first as the biggest safety gap where risk drops fastest.
The class with most samples is often already good; sample-count allocation conflicts with fixing the weakest safety class.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Budget allocation skews limited labeling budget toward the lowest tail-class mAP, fixing the biggest safety gap first.
